title: ServicesEnum
description:
* `Anonymous Call Rejection` - When enabled, blocks all incoming calls from unidentified or blocked caller IDs.
 * `Authentication` - Requires the user to enter a password before making a call.
 * `Call Forwarding Always` - Forwards all incoming calls to another number.
 * `Call Forwarding Busy` - Forwards incoming calls to another number when the user is on another call.
 * `Call Forwarding No Answer` - Forwards incoming calls to another number when the user does not answer.
 * `Call Notify` - Notifies the user of incoming calls.
 * `Calling Line ID Delivery Blocking` - Blocks the delivery of the user's caller ID to the recipient.
 * `Do Not Disturb` - Blocks all incoming calls.
 * `Intercept User` - Allows the user to intercept another user's calls.
 * `Last Number Redial` - Redials the last number called.
 * `Priority Alert` - Alerts the user of incoming calls with a distinctive ring.
 * `Call Return` - Returns the last call received.
 * `Selective Call Acceptance` - Accepts only calls from a list of pre-approved numbers.
 * `Call Forwarding Selective` - Forwards calls from a list of pre-approved numbers.
 * `Selective Call Rejection` - Rejects calls from a list of pre-approved numbers.
 * `Simultaneous Ring Personal` - Rings multiple numbers at the same time.
 * `Voice Messaging User` - Allows the user to access voicemail.
 * `Alternate Numbers` - Allows the user to have multiple numbers.
 * `Shared Call Appearance 35` - Allows the user to share a call appearance with another user.
 * `Speed Dial 100` - Allows the user to dial a number by pressing a single key.
 * `Directed Call Pickup` - Allows the user to pick up a call directed to another user.
 * `Directed Call Pickup with Barge-in` - Allows the user to pick up a call directed to another user and join the call.
 * `External Calling Line ID Delivery` - Displays the caller's ID on the user's phone.
 * `Internal Calling Line ID Delivery` - Displays the caller's ID on the user's phone.
 * `Call Waiting` - Alerts the user of incoming calls when they are on another call.
 * `Barge-in Exempt` - Prevents other users from barging in on the user's calls.
 * `Push to Talk` - Allows the user to push a button to talk.
 * `Basic Call Logs` - Logs the user's call history.
 * `Hoteling Host` - Allows the user to host a hoteling session.
 * `Hoteling Guest` - Allows the user to join a hoteling session.
 * `Multiple Call Arrangement` - Allows the user to have multiple calls at the same time.
 * `Busy Lamp Field` - Allows the user to monitor the status of another user's phone.
 * `Three-Way Call` - Allows the user to have a three-way call.
 * `Call Transfer` - Allows the user to transfer a call.
 * `Privacy` - Allows the user to keep their number private.
 * `Fax Messaging` - Allows the user to send and receive faxes.
 * `N-Way Call` - Allows the user to have an N-way call.
 * `Call Forwarding Not Reachable` - Forwards calls when the user is not reachable.
 * `Connected Line Identification Presentation` - Displays the caller's ID on the user's phone.
 * `Connected Line Identification Restriction` - Prevents the caller's ID from being displayed on the user's phone.
 * `BroadWorks Anywhere` - Allows the user to make calls from any phone.
 * `Music On Hold User` - Allows the user to listen to music while on hold.
 * `Call Center Monitoring` - Allows the user to monitor a call center.
 * `BroadWorks Mobility` - Allows the user to use BroadWorks Mobility.
 * `Call Recording` - Allows the user to record calls.
 * `Executive` - Allows the user to have an executive assistant.
 * `Client License 17` - Allows the user to use client license 17.
 * `Client License 18` - Allows the user to use client license 18.
 * `Flexible Seating Guest` - Allows the user to be a flexible seating guest.
 * `Personal Assistant` - Allows the user to have a personal assistant.
 * `Sequential Ring` - Allows the user to have a sequential ring.
 * `Call Block` - Allows the user to block calls.
